description: Use this when the person asks who is on their distribution list for data sheets. Lists the distribution list of the connected account: address, company, confirmed or unsubscribed, and whether a recipient gets all products or only some. Do not use to send anything or to see deliveries (use list_delivery_proofs).

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

query.description: Part of the address, company or name

name: list_recipients
title: Distribution list
